portfolio_issues: APA, PBF, DAR and LPG are all primarily driven by oil price, creating a ~19% concentrated, correlated oil bet exactly when macro flags a binary Hormuz escalation and two-sided oil de-escalation risk.
RS is topped up to 10% weight despite the committee's own debate judge ruling bear and after being sold in the last 60 days, with no new evidence bridging the gap.
DAR is bought as a 'new position' only weeks after being sold with an identical bull/bear debate record, a flip-flop without new catalysts.
DRH adds a large travel/consumer-discretionary-like exposure via a hotel REIT just as macro highlights consumer-spending contraction risk from depleted savings and high mortgage rates.
Health Care (~22%) and Financials (~18%) sector weights are now parked exactly at their macro-allowed ceilings, leaving no buffer heading into the Dec 8-9 FOMC binary event.
T04's stated rationale references an unrelated ticker (MGEE) not held in the portfolio, indicating a possible process or data error in the sell logic.
